All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IAnyResource, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasModifierExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseResource, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IDomainResource
public class FhirDevice extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Device
This class is a subclass of Device. Therefore it contains information about a manufactured item that is used in health care.
It contains functionalities for converting author of CDA R2 into HL7 FHIR Device and vice versa.

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040AuthoringDevice getAtcdabbrOtherDeviceCompilation(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Device fhirDevice)

    • getHl7CdaR2Pocdmt000040AssignedAuthor

      public static org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040AssignedAuthor getHl7CdaR2Pocdmt000040AssignedAuthor(org.husky.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040AssignedAuthor assignedAuthor, org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Device device)
      Adds details to CDA R2 POCDMT000040AssignedAuthor with passed device as author. This method adds organization of author (owner of device). Moreover it adds contact details (details for support) and identifier of device.
      Parameters:
      assignedAuthor - author to add details
      device - resource to be extracted
      Returns:
      assigned author with added details
